input.prompt: A long, stiff, empty-feeling banquet table in a large cavernous hall, rows of untouched place settings, a bored executive in a dark suit sitting alone glancing at his wristwatch, cold blue-grey lighting. Cinematic, luxury, high-end corporate film. Deep black and charcoal palette, with subtle hot pink (#FF1FA9) and warm gold-yellow (#FCD500) neon rim light and soft neon glow rings. Shallow depth of field, anamorphic lens flares, slow gimbal movement, rich shadows, filmic grain. No on-screen text, no logos, no watermarks.
